source.author: verg
source.text: Ut pelagus tenuere rates, nec iam amplius ulla occurrit tellus, maria undique et undique caelum, olli caeruleus supra caput astitit imber, noctem hiememque ferens, et inhorruit unda tenebris.
source.text_original: Ut pelagus tenuere rates, nec iam amplius ulla / occurrit tellus, maria undique et undique caelum, / olli caeruleus supra caput astitit imber, / noctem hiememque ferens, et inhorruit unda tenebris.
source.text_english: When the ships had held the open sea, and no land now appeared any longer, on every side only sea and on every side sky, over their heads there stood a dark blue rain-cloud, bringing night and winter, and the wave bristled darkly.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: nunc mihi euanescentibus terris caelum undique et undique pontus, nunc unda tenebris inhorrescens et caeca nocte nimborum spumei fluctus canescunt.
reuse.text_original: nunc mihi euanescentibus terris caelum undique et undique pontus, nunc unda tenebris inhorrescens et caeca nocte nimborum spumei fluctus canescunt.
reuse.text_english: Now, the earth fading away from me, heaven is all around and all around the sea; now the water, bristling in the darkness, and in blind night of storms, the foaming waves grow white.
